t: How to Use the Reports Section in Thrive Apprentice
c:
In this article, you'll learn how to navigate the reports dashboard in Thrive Apprentice—including viewing course progress reports, enrollment statistics, completion rates, and filtering and exporting your data.

Prerequisites

Before you begin, make sure you have:

  • Thrive Apprentice installed and activated on your WordPress site.
  • At least one published course with enrolled students.

Accessing the Reports Section

  1. In your WordPress dashboard, navigate to Thrive Dashboard > Thrive Apprentice.
  2. Click the Reports tab in the left sidebar.

The reports dashboard gives you a centralized view of all student activity across your courses. From here, you can track enrollment trends, monitor progress, and identify where students may be getting stuck or dropping off.

Understanding the Reports Dashboard

The reports dashboard is organized into several key sections that give you a complete picture of your course performance.

  • Enrollment Overview — Displays the total number of students enrolled across all courses, along with trends over time (daily, weekly, or monthly).
  • Course Progress — Shows how far students have progressed through each course, broken down by lesson or module completion.
  • Completion Rates — Highlights the percentage of students who have fully completed each course, helping you identify courses with high drop-off.
  • Activity Timeline — Provides a chronological view of recent student actions, including enrollments, lesson completions, and course completions.

Viewing Course-Specific Reports

To drill down into the data for a specific course:

  1. In the Reports section, locate the course list or use the course filter dropdown.
  2. Select the course you want to analyze.
  3. Review the course-specific metrics that appear, including: - Total enrolled students for this course. - Average progress percentage across all students. - Number of students who have completed the course. - Lesson-by-lesson completion breakdown.

Tip: Pay attention to lessons with a significant drop in completion compared to the previous lesson. This often indicates content that is too difficult, too long, or not engaging enough—giving you a clear signal for where to improve.

Filtering Report Data

Filters help you narrow down the data to find exactly what you're looking for.

  1. At the top of the reports dashboard, locate the filter controls.
  2. Apply filters based on the available criteria: - Date Range — Select a start and end date to view data for a specific time period. - Course — Choose a specific course or view data across all courses. - Status — Filter by student status, such as enrolled, in progress, or completed.
  3. Click Apply or the filter will update automatically, depending on the interface.

Note: Combining multiple filters gives you more precise results. For example, you can view all students who enrolled in a specific course during the last 30 days and are currently in progress.

Exporting Report Data

You can export your reports for external analysis or record-keeping.

  1. Navigate to the report view you want to export.
  2. Apply any filters to narrow down the data to the set you need.
  3. Click the Export button (typically located near the top-right of the report).
  4. Choose your preferred export format (CSV is the most common).
  5. Save the file to your computer.

Tip: Exported CSV files can be opened in spreadsheet applications like Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel for further analysis, charting, or integration with other business tools.

Key Metrics to Monitor

Here are the most important metrics to track regularly:

  • Enrollment Rate — How many new students are joining your courses over time.
  • Completion Rate — The percentage of enrolled students who finish the entire course.
  • Average Progress — How far the typical student gets before stopping.
  • Lesson Drop-Off Points — Specific lessons where students tend to stop progressing.
  • Time to Completion — How long it takes the average student to finish a course.

That's it! You've successfully learned how to use the Reports section in Thrive Apprentice to monitor your courses, track student progress, and make data-driven decisions about your content.

t: How to View Member Related Data in Thrive Apprentice
c:
In this article, you'll learn how to view individual member data in Thrive Apprentice—including course enrollment status, progress tracking, completion history, and member activity details.

Prerequisites

Before you begin, make sure you have:

  • Thrive Apprentice installed and activated on your WordPress site.
  • At least one course with enrolled students.

Accessing the Members Section

  1. In your WordPress dashboard, navigate to Thrive Dashboard > Thrive Apprentice.
  2. Click the Members tab in the left sidebar.

The Members section displays a list of all registered users who have interacted with your courses. From here, you can search for specific members, browse the full list, and click into individual profiles for detailed information.

Viewing the Members List

The main members list gives you a high-level overview of your student base.

  • Name and Email — Each entry shows the member's display name and email address for easy identification.
  • Enrolled Courses — A summary of how many courses the member is enrolled in.
  • Overall Progress — A quick indicator of the member's progress across their enrolled courses.
  • Status — Shows whether the member is active, has completed courses, or has been inactive.

Tip: Use the search bar at the top of the members list to quickly find a specific student by name or email address.

Viewing an Individual Member's Profile

To see detailed data for a specific student:

  1. In the Members list, click on the student's name to open their profile.
  2. The member profile page displays all relevant data for that student.

The profile is organized into several areas of information:

Course Enrollment Status

This section shows every course the member is enrolled in, along with:

  • Course Name — The title of each enrolled course.
  • Enrollment Date — When the student was granted access to the course.
  • Access Type — How the student gained access (e.g., through a product purchase, manual enrollment, or free access).

Progress Tracking

For each enrolled course, you can see the student's detailed progress:

  • Completion Percentage — A visual progress bar showing how much of the course the student has finished.
  • Lessons Completed — A count and list of completed lessons.
  • Current Lesson — The lesson the student last accessed or is currently working on.
  • Modules Completed — If the course uses modules, you can see which modules are fully completed.

Completion History

If the student has finished one or more courses, the completion history section displays:

  • Completed Courses — A list of all courses the student has finished.
  • Completion Dates — The date each course was completed.
  • Certificates — If certificates are enabled, you can see whether the student has a certificate available and access it directly.

Member Activity

The activity section provides a timeline of the student's interactions:

  • Recent Actions — A chronological log of lesson views, lesson completions, and course completions.
  • Last Active Date — When the student last accessed any course content.

Searching and Filtering Members

When you have a large number of students, searching and filtering helps you find the information you need quickly.

  1. Use the Search bar at the top of the Members list to find students by name or email.
  2. Use the available filters to narrow the list: - Course — Show only members enrolled in a specific course. - Status — Filter by active, completed, or inactive members. - Date Range — View members who enrolled within a specific time period.
  3. The list updates automatically as you apply filters.

Note: Filters can be combined. For example, you can filter for all active members enrolled in a specific course who joined in the last month.

That's it! You've successfully learned how to view member-related data in Thrive Apprentice, giving you full visibility into each student's enrollment, progress, and activity.

  • Sorting by Enrollment Date: Learn how to sort students by enrollment date for quick organization.
  • Managing Members: Review how to manage members and adjust course access.

t: How to Sort Students by Enrollment Date in Thrive Apprentice
c:
In this article, you'll learn how to sort and filter your student list by enrollment date in the Thrive Apprentice members section—helping you quickly identify recent enrollments, track cohorts, and manage your student base.

Prerequisites

Before you begin, make sure you have:

  • Thrive Apprentice installed and activated on your WordPress site.
  • At least one course with enrolled students.

Accessing the Members List

  1. In your WordPress dashboard, navigate to Thrive Dashboard > Thrive Apprentice.
  2. Click the Members tab in the left sidebar.

The members list shows all registered students along with their enrollment details.

Sorting Students by Enrollment Date

You can sort the student list to display members in order of when they enrolled.

  1. In the Members list, locate the column headers at the top of the table.
  2. Click on the Enrollment Date column header to sort by date.
  3. Click once to sort in ascending order (oldest enrollments first).
  4. Click again to switch to descending order (newest enrollments first).

Tip: Sorting by newest first is the most useful view when you want to check who recently joined your courses or verify that new enrollments are coming in as expected.

Filtering by Date Range

If you need to view students who enrolled during a specific time period, you can use the date range filter.

  1. At the top of the Members list, look for the filter controls.
  2. Select the Date Range filter.
  3. Choose a Start Date and End Date to define the enrollment window.
  4. The list will update to show only students who enrolled within the selected time frame.

Note: You can combine the date range filter with other filters, such as filtering by a specific course. This allows you to see all students who enrolled in a particular course during a given month, for example.

Filtering by Course

To narrow down the list even further, you can filter students by a specific course alongside the enrollment date sort.

  1. Use the Course filter dropdown to select the course you want to view.
  2. The list updates to show only students enrolled in that course.
  3. With the course filter active, click the Enrollment Date column header to sort those students by their enrollment date.

Practical Use Cases

Here are some common scenarios where sorting by enrollment date is helpful:

  • Tracking Launch Results — After launching a new course, sort by newest enrollment date to see sign-ups rolling in and monitor early adoption.
  • Managing Cohorts — If you run cohort-based courses, filter by the enrollment date range that corresponds to each cohort to view those specific students.
  • Identifying Inactive Students — Sort by oldest enrollment date and cross-reference with progress data to find students who enrolled long ago but haven't made progress.
  • Support and Onboarding — View recent enrollees to proactively reach out with welcome messages or onboarding resources.

That's it! You've successfully learned how to sort and filter students by enrollment date in Thrive Apprentice, making it easy to manage and monitor your student base.

Related Resources

  • Viewing Member Data: Learn how to view detailed member data including progress and completion history.
  • Reports Section: Use the Reports section for aggregated enrollment statistics and trends.
  • Managing Members: Review how to manage members and adjust access settings.
  • Manual Lesson Unlocking: Learn how to manually unlock lessons for specific students when needed.

t: How to Unlock a Lesson for Users Manually in Thrive Apprentice
c:
In this article, you'll learn how to manually unlock specific lessons for individual students in Thrive Apprentice—useful for granting exceptions, troubleshooting access issues, or providing bonus content outside of your normal course progression rules.

Prerequisites

Before you begin, make sure you have:

  • Thrive Apprentice installed and activated on your WordPress site.
  • At least one published course with enrolled students.
  • The student whose lesson you want to unlock must already have an account on your site.

When to Manually Unlock a Lesson

Manual lesson unlocking is helpful in situations where the standard conditional access rules don't apply. Common scenarios include:

  • Granting Exceptions — A student needs to skip ahead due to prior knowledge or special circumstances.
  • Troubleshooting Access Issues — A student reports that a lesson is locked when it shouldn't be, and you need to resolve the issue quickly.
  • Providing Bonus Content — You want to give a specific student access to a premium or restricted lesson as a reward or incentive.
  • Beta Testing — You're testing new course content and need to give select students early access to specific lessons.

Unlocking a Lesson from the Member Profile

The most straightforward way to manually unlock a lesson is through the student's member profile.

  1. In your WordPress dashboard, navigate to Thrive Dashboard > Thrive Apprentice.
  2. Click the Members tab in the left sidebar.
  3. Search for and click on the student's name to open their profile.
  4. Locate the course that contains the lesson you want to unlock.
  5. Find the specific lesson in the student's course progress view.
  6. Click the Unlock option next to the locked lesson.
  7. Confirm the action when prompted.

The lesson is now immediately accessible to that student. They will be able to view and interact with the lesson content the next time they access the course.

Note: Manually unlocking a lesson for one student does not affect other students. All other students will continue to follow the standard access rules and conditions you've configured for the course.

Unlocking a Lesson from the Course View

You can also approach manual unlocking from the course side rather than the member side.

  1. Navigate to Thrive Apprentice > Courses.
  2. Open the course that contains the lesson you want to unlock.
  3. Click on the specific lesson to view its settings.
  4. Look for the student access or enrollment section within the lesson settings.
  5. Search for the student by name or email.
  6. Click Unlock next to the student's entry to grant them access to this lesson.
  7. Click Save if required.

Important Considerations

Keep the following in mind when manually unlocking lessons:

  • Override Scope — A manual unlock overrides the conditional access rules for that specific lesson and student only. It does not change the course-wide settings or affect other lessons.
  • Progress Tracking — The student's progress will still be tracked normally. If they skip lessons through a manual unlock, their overall completion percentage may appear inconsistent until they go back and complete the skipped content.
  • Drip Schedules — If the lesson is part of a drip schedule, manually unlocking it will make it available immediately, bypassing the scheduled release date for that student.
  • Reversibility — Depending on your setup, you may be able to re-lock a lesson after unlocking it. Check the lesson settings in the student's profile for this option.

Tip: If you find yourself manually unlocking lessons frequently for the same reason, consider adjusting your course's conditional access rules or creating a separate user role with different access permissions. This will save you time and reduce manual intervention.

That's it! You've successfully learned how to manually unlock lessons for individual students in Thrive Apprentice, giving you the flexibility to handle exceptions and special cases without changing your course structure.
